Frequently Asked Questions

What is InfoJoy?

InfoJoy is MarketJoy’s AI-powered B2B prospecting platform that delivers buyer intent signals, verified contacts, and account-level insights to help sales and marketing teams accelerate growth.

How accurate is the contact data?

Our platform verifies emails, phone numbers, and company details across 5,000+ data sources to ensure maximum accuracy.

Can InfoJoy integrate with my CRM or marketing automation system?

Yes, InfoJoy seamlessly integrates with popular CRMs and marketing automation tools to keep your workflows connected.

How is pricing structured?

We offer flexible annual plans and credit-based models so you only pay for what you need.

Who can benefit from InfoJoy?

InfoJoy is perfect for sales teams, business development reps, account managers, and marketers looking to save time, improve targeting, and boost ROI.
